decision: Drop of 35 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Engine (ICE) 5th Turbocharger (TC) 5th Exhaust Set (EXH) 5th MGU-K
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 a) and b) and c) and f) (read with B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 35 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. In this case, the use of the (MGU-K) carries a 5 grid place penalty by virtue of Article B8.2.8 b) of the FIA F1 Regulations and the use of the (ICE), (TC) and (EXH) additional element(s) carries a 10 grid place penalty by virtue of Article B8.2.8 a) of the FIA F1 Regulations. Therefore, there is an accumulation of 35 places. Subject to Car 87 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 87 will be allocated a grid position in the Race in accordance with Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Changes To Pu Elements
